turns.message: Please do a general code review of this utility library. Use README.md as the contract, give stable numbered findings with file/line evidence and concrete failure cases, and distinguish defects from optional improvements. Do not change product files.
turns.response:
Found eight existing contract defects, reproduced with local synthetic fixtures. Stable finding numbers:

1. **[P1] Approval tokens ignore index contents.** [cleanup.mjs:6](WORKSPACE/src/cleanup.mjs:6) lists indexed paths but hashes only working-tree bytes. Stage `A`, then stage `B` and restore working-tree `A`: the token remains unchanged despite the changed index. Include index blob IDs, modes, and stages in the token.

2. **[P1] Evidence redaction leaves sensitive values exposed.** [privacy.mjs:3](WORKSPACE/src/privacy.mjs:3) matches `token=value`, whereas JSON uses `"token":"value"`. Top-level `token` and nested `Password`/`SECRET` values survive unchanged. Unrelated `{note:"token=hello"}` instead throws a JSON parse error. Recursively copy JSON values and redact according to property names.

3. **[P1] Secret replacement operates on JSON syntax rather than string values.** [transcript.mjs:3](WORKSPACE/src/transcript.mjs:3) cannot match raw secrets containing quotes, backslashes, or newlines after serialization; those secrets return intact. Secrets such as `"true"` or `"123"` also replace boolean/number syntax and cause parsing failures. Traverse the original structure and transform string values only.

4. **[P2] Atomic replacement discards existing access permissions.** [atomic.mjs:5](WORKSPACE/src/atomic.mjs:5) always creates the replacement with mode `0600`. Replacing a file with mode `0754` changes its mode to `0600`, removing executable and shared-read permissions. Apply the existing file’s access mode to the temporary file before renaming; retain private permissions for new files.

5. **[P2] Fingerprints falsely report complete coverage when links exist.** [fingerprint.mjs:9](WORKSPACE/src/fingerprint.mjs:9) skips symbolic links, but line 15 always returns `complete:true`. Adding a link to an external target leaves the digest unchanged and still reports complete coverage. Record incomplete coverage whenever a link is encountered, while continuing to avoid following it.

6. **[P2] Eventual assertions neither retry nor enforce their timeout.** [browser.mjs:2](WORKSPACE/src/browser.mjs:2) reads once. A reader returning `"loading"` and then `"ready"` fails immediately; a reader whose promise never settles remains pending beyond its timeout. Retry mismatches until a deadline and enforce that deadline while awaiting a reader. Preserve reader-error propagation.

7. **[P2] Retired rules cannot be moved.** [rules.mjs:3](WORKSPACE/src/rules.mjs:3) requires `rule.active` when locating the ID. Moving an existing rule with `active:false` throws `Unknown rule`, contrary to the explicit retired-rule contract. Locate by ID and preserve its existing active state.

8. **[P2] Ambiguous hash encoding hides additional file-state changes.** [cleanup.mjs:9](WORKSPACE/src/cleanup.mjs:9) and [fingerprint.mjs:11](WORKSPACE/src/fingerprint.mjs:11) concatenate paths and contents without framing content boundaries. A single file `a` containing `xb<NUL>y` hashes identically to files `a="x"` and `b="y"`. Separately, deleting a tracked file containing exactly `missing` leaves its cleanup token unchanged. Encode lengths and explicit presence/type markers before hashing.

Verification: 28 temporary checks produced **15 failing contract assertions and 13 passing controls**, using Node v26.7.0 and Git 2.43.1. Temporary fixtures were removed; source and README hashes remained unchanged. No network access or commits occurred.

Optional improvement: add a regression suite covering these contracts. None was supplied. Crash durability and non-JSON input support were excluded from the findings because the README does not require them.
